product_constraint: 1.5x-3x same-request real API Decode, d2/d3, exact target state/logits/output and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total

downward_budget.scope: Opportunity ceiling only; QK alone cannot close the whole gap even if eliminated. Bounded composition prerequisite, not target relaxation.

mechanism: Publish 32 immutable K positions per CTA once, then consume 16 original two-position iterations without inner producer barriers. Four publications retain the original 128-position output tile, query ownership, score staging and scalar arithmetic.
equivalence_ledger: Original query/key 8-product trees, ordered pair merges, warp reductions and 0.0625 scale unchanged.
Causal per-row predicates and physical scores indexing unchanged.
Cooperative 16-byte copies cover all 32*256 BF16 elements; invalid positions zero-filled and never consumed.
All copies wait before uniform CTA publication; a uniform retirement barrier precedes next overwrite. No consumer reads a partial tile.

Shared K storage grows from 4096 to 16384 bytes; total shared M2/3/4=22528/25600/28672 bytes. One fixed 32-position block keeps M2 producer at eight copies/thread and avoids a whole-128-position allocation.
No new persistent allocation, state, Prefill, PV, launch grid or projection change.
distinction: Rejected v53 merely merged duplicate barriers in the same two-position four-stage ring. This replaces that ring with immutable bulk publication and amortizes producer ownership across sixteen iterations. No continuation of a barrier or tile scan.
reference_translation: Existing licensed FlashInfer-derived cooperative cp.async delivery and grouped-query ownership, translated to a bulk immutable SM87 tile. No imported source or new ISA.
gates: P513 complete prefixes/transactions and P8192 complete prefixes
immediate d2 API vs retained v52; >3% slowdown stops, useful unlocks d3, otherwise remove
expiry: Useful dependency only until next complete verifier API return or archival; no production promotion or tile/pipeline scan.
